desc: Pandavula Gutta is an ancient geological site and cave located near Kothapally village in Regonda mandal of Jayashankar Bhupalpally district in the Indian state of Telangana. It was designated as the only geoheritage site of Telangana. Telangana tourism and Forest department developed the entire area into a significant ecotourism centre.
fact: It was designated as the only geoheritage site of Telangana · The site is situated 55 k.m from Warangal
